summary: Canadian Imperial Bank of Commerce filed a Form 6-K reporting the election of 13 director nominees at its 2026 Annual and Special Meeting, as disclosed in a news release and voting results. All management-recommended nominees received strong shareholder support, with votes for ranging from 94.91% to 99.65%. The filing is a routine post-meeting report required for foreign private issuers, containing no special-situation catalysts such as activist campaigns, strategic changes, or capital events. No deal terms or advisor involvement are present. This is a standard corporate governance update with no actionable special-situation elements.
